title: Agentic search
content: Agentic search is a search experience in which an AI agent runs several searches, compares what it finds, and can complete a task for the person, such as booking a reservation.

meta.why: An agent reads your page to finish a task for someone else. Prices, availability, and policies need to sit in text the agent can read.
meta.example: A shopper asks an assistant to find a standing desk within a set budget, and the agent opens several product pages to compare dimensions and return policies.
meta.check: Complete a key task on your site using the keyboard alone. Google says browser agents read the page structure and the accessibility tree.
meta.limitation: Agent features differ by product and region, and a site an agent can read is still one option among those the agent compares.
